title: ApexPlanner MCP Tools — Sample JSON-RPC / MCP Tool Descriptors
description: Sample tool schemas illustrating the MCP handshake surface. Not a complete server manifest; normative wire and tools: full ApexPlanner repository docs/mcp-contract.md.

protocolVersion.description: MCP protocol revision targeted by this sample.

tools.name: get_architectural_skeleton
tools.description: Return a token-bounded architectural skeleton for indexed sources under path: signatures, types, and doc comments preserved; bodies elided. Optional graph and ordering strategies for monorepo-scale workspaces.

path.description: Workspace-relative or absolute path (file or directory).

max_tokens.description: Hard cap on returned token estimate; truncation is reported in the response envelope.

include_locked_only.description: If true, restrict listing to intent-locked nodes only.

include_graph.description: If true, include deterministic nodes and import edges for the same scope.

file_order.description: Ordering strategy: lexicographic path vs hot-first monorepo heuristics.

include_rollup.description: If true and response is partial, include one-line rollup hints for elided paths.

tools.name: check_compliance_ledger
tools.description: Read-only query of the local compliance ledger: recent MCP tool invocations, consent metadata, redaction counts, and path arguments suitable for audit export. Returns structured JSON for programmatic consumers.

limit.description: Maximum ledger rows to return, newest first.

since_iso8601.description: Optional inclusive lower bound on stored timestamps (UTC, ISO-8601).

tool_filter.description: Optional allow-list of tool names; omit for all tools.

include_redaction_breakdown.description: If true, include per-row redaction tallies when available.
